title: Uncovering the Limits of Proof Sharing for Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.19351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robustness verification of neural networks is increasingly important, due to their use in many critical domains. In certain scenarios, proof sharing has been shown to accelerate incomplete verification techniques by reusing intermediate-layer abstract states, or templates, across queries. However, questions remain as to the robustness of template-based acceleration across varying network architectures, properties, datasets, and training methods. In this work, we perform a systematic study of the effectiveness of template-based acceleration and its limits. Our study shows that template subsumption rates can vary widely across scenarios. We present a novel metric of jointly stable neurons to explain this variation, showing that in some cases template-based techniques are very unlikely to provide any speedup. translated_title: 揭示神经网络证明共享的局限性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19351v1 公告类型：新 摘要：神经网络在众多关键领域的应用日益广泛，因此其鲁棒性验证变得越来越重要。在某些场景中，已证明通过跨查询重用中间层抽象状态或模板，可以加速不完整的验证技术。然而，关于基于模板的加速在不同网络架构、属性、数据集和训练方法中的稳健性问题仍然存在。在本研究中，我们对基于模板的加速效果及其局限性进行了系统性研究。研究表明，模板包含率在不同场景下差异显著。我们提出了一种新的联合稳定神经元指标来解释这种变化，显示在某些情况下，基于模板的技术极不可能提供任何加速效果。然后，我们提出了FastCert，一种自动在神经网络各层间分布模板以提高性能的新技术。
tldr: 本研究系统分析了神经网络证明共享中模板加速的局限性，提出联合稳定神经元指标解释其效果差异，并开发了FastCert技术以自动优化模板分布。
en_tdlr: This study systematically analyzes the limits of template-based acceleration in neural network proof sharing, proposes a jointly stable neuron metric to explain performance variation, and develops FastCert to automatically optimize template distribution.
